Gwenda's attempts to settle into her new home are complicated by strange occurrences. More than just the echoes of time, she is plagued by an irrational sense of dread every time she ascends the stairs. Fearful, she even calls upon Miss Marple for help against ghostly apparitions. However, the creeping supernatural tension quickly gives way to a much darker realization: there is a "perfect crime" that must be solvedâa crime committed many years ago and seemingly vanished without a trace.

**Is this book suitable for fans of Miss Marple?**
